title: Cutover evacuation playbook + retro template (Quickstrike lane)
content:
Purpose:
This is a focused playbook for high-priority "quickstrike" launches where we may need to rapidly stop traffic, evacuate a release lane, or perform an emergency rollback while preserving forensics and minimizing customer impact. Includes an actionable cutover checklist, a 72-hour stabilization calendar, a lightweight release-notes draft, and a retro template for followups.

Scope and when to use:
- Use for feature flips or infra changes with one-hour blast radius risk, or when SRE/Release Engineering expect possible need to rollback within the first 72 hours.
- Not intended for full-scale platform incidents (SRE incident runbooks should be used in that case).

Quickstrike cutover checklist (pre-cutover, <48h):
- Owner: release lead (Maya Chen). Backup owner assigned.
- Confirm canary cohort configured (5% traffic) and health endpoints wired.
- Verify A/B or feature flag exists and a mapped rollback toggle exists.
- Ensure telemetry sampling bumped to 100% for affected routes for 4 hours post-cutover.
- Pre-warm caches and KV shards; document shard IDs in cut logs.
- Staging smoke tests: run smoke-suite-v2 (ticket JIRA-TEST-77) and capture traces.
- Identify dependent services and ensure cross-team contacts are paged to the cut calendar slot.
- Prepare emergency fallback images and tagged roll-forward artifacts: image: release/quickstrike:2026-10-02-preview; fallback: release/stable:2026-09-20.
- Create a short public-facing incident template for CS in case customers ping during stabilization.

During cutover (T-0 to T+30m):
- Start: announce on #release-ops with tagged rotation and list of on-call engineers.
- Reduce canary if anomaly detected: cut traffic by 50% and hold for 10 minutes.
- Monitor error budget dashboards (latency 99p, error rate, token drop) at 1m cadence for first 15 minutes then 5m.
- If any single region latency >2x baseline or error rate >1% absolute increase: pause and escalate.
- If critical (page SRE): evacuate lane (see Evacuation steps).

Immediate verification (T+30m to T+2h):
- Run full smoke tests and targeted evals against prompt set: quickstrike-eval-v1.
- Check tracing for increased tail-latency or memory spikes.
- Confirm cache hit rate within expected delta.
- Post a short release summary to #release-ops with pass/fail and next steps.

Rollback / Evacuation trigger conditions:
- Sustained error rate >2% or increasing trend for 15 minutes.
- Unrecoverable model degradation (quality regression >X on golden prompts).
- Unexpected region-wide infra anomalies (node eviction, network partitions).
- Manual customer-blocking issues reported by CS + product.

Evacuation steps (ordered):
1) Execute feature-flag off (primary rollback). Document exact toggle and timestamp.
2) If toggle fails, route traffic to fallback model variant (route policy: region->dedicated-fallback).
3) Disable gateway routing for affected lanes (load-balancer graceful drain).
4) If still impacted, roll image to stable: release/stable:2026-09-20 and restart pods in controlled waves (10% at a time).
5) Preserve logs and KV snapshots: take KV snapshot id and store in artifacts bucket with retention tag 'cutover-quickstrike-20261002'.
6) Communicate to stakeholders (CS, Legal if required, Growth) using the public-facing template.

Forensics and data preservation:
- Tag traces with header X-Release-Cut: quickstrike-2026-10-02.
- Collect sample request ids for 1000 failed requests across regions; store list in S3 path: s3://redwood-release-ops/forensics/quickstrike-2026-10-02/failed-ids.txt.
- Snapshot model KV caches and saved weights pointers.

72-hour stabilization calendar (owner/time slots):
- Day 0 (cut day): 00:00-03:00 immediate smoke + triage (release lead, SRE), 03:00-09:00 observation (on-call), 09:00-18:00 rapid followups and minor rollups (product + release eng).
- Day 1: morning deep-dive (10:00) with telemetry owners; afternoon small-correct patch window (14:00-16:00) for low-risk fixes.
- Day 2: performance regression run and canary expansion plan (11:00), soft-expansion to 50% if metrics look healthy.
- Day 3: final expansion review (15:00); if green, schedule formal release notes and close cut ops.

Meeting cadence during stabilization:
- Standup: 09:30 daily in #release-ops (15m).
- Triage bridge for high-sev: immediately escalate to SRE bridge (Zoom link in linked_artifacts).

Release-notes draft (public-facing, minimal):
Title: Quickstrike launch: profanity-filter-v2 + routing optimization
Summary: Small release that improves model-side filtering and reduces tail-latency for routing on short prompts. Rolled out to 5% canary on 2026-10-02 for rapid verification.
Highlights:
- profanity-filter-v2: improved false-positive reduction on short-form prompts (internal evals).
- routing optimization: improves average latency on short sequences by ~8%.
Known issues:
- Minor transient 503 spikes possible in warmup windows for <10min. We have rollback toggle ready.
How to contact us: support@redwood.ai and internal CS escalation flow.

Postmortem/retro template (fill during stabilization end):
- Short description (one sentence):
- Timeline (events and timestamps):
- Impact (scope, customers affected):
- Root cause (primary + contributing):
- Detection: how discovered? which dashboards/alerts triggered?
- Mitigation steps taken: what stopped the bleeding?
- Long-term action items (owner, ETA):
- Follow-up audits (data retention, alert tuning):
- Lessons learned (what to keep/do differently):

Open questions / notes-to-self:
- Confirm whether telemetry sampling ramp should be persistent for 7 days or trimmed after 48h. (action: Arjun Patel).
- Should we add a mandatory staged database-migration dry run for any change touching KV shard mapping? (discuss in Oct 12 ops retro).

Appendix: quick links and tickets to reconcile after cut:
- Forensics bucket (write-only): s3://redwood-release-ops/forensics/quickstrike-2026-10-02/
- Triggered tickets: JIRA-RELEASE-318 (release plan), JIRA-INC-901 (followup trace), GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-ops/pull/456

Draft changelog (sparse):
- feat: profanity-filter-v2 (reduced false positives)
- perf: routing-optimizer short-seq path (avg latency -8%)
- fix: rare race in prefix cache priming (partial mitigation applied)

Next steps (before closing cut ops):
- Complete retro and open action items in Confluence (owner: Maya).
- Publish formal release notes after Day 3 if stabilization green.
- Archive emergency artifacts and tag repo.

Loose checklist for archive (post-close):
- Ensure KV snapshot retention set to 90 days.
- Close all temporary tickets and move lessons to knowledge base.
- Reconcile costs for emergency scale-up and record in finance ticket FIN-2026-RL.

Notes (informal):
- This doc intentionally lightweight — it should be call-to-action rather than exhaustive.
- Keep this template small so on-call can run it without reading a long playbook.
- TODO: Add automated script entries for toggling features (GH: release-ops/scripts/toggle-flag.sh).
